root_cause.mechanism: brain._react_monster gates attacks on self._choice(answers, 'react_monster', 'ignore') — but build_decision_request's question schema has NO react_monster question: the server answers next_action/target_choice/should_reply/hp_critical/threat_near/accept_invite/use_premade/premade_pick/chat_urgency/goal_review. The real Clef therefore can never answer react_monster -> the default 'ignore' -> 'monster ignored' -> 0 actions, EVERY tick, silently.
root_cause.why_engagement_ever_happened: The engagement came from the PLAN/GOAL path (the goal_review -> the FarmPlan/GrindScript authoring -> the scripts step on the state independently of the decide), not from the reactive path. The reactive path (the decide-driven attacks) has been dead against the real Clef since the SystemOne schema was adopted.
